newsitem.title: USA: Kaiser Aluminum to redeem preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: Kaiser Aluminum to redeem preferred stock.

text.p: Kaiser Aluminum Corp said on Thursday it will redeem all 8,673,850 outstanding shares of its 8.255 percent PRIDES convertible preferred stock on August 29.

The company said that upon redemption, holders of the convertible preferred stock will receive 0.8333 of a share of Kaiser common stock in exchange for each share of convertible preferred stock they own, plus cash for any fractional shares.

Holders may convert each share of convertible preferred stock into 0.8333 of a share of Kaiser common stock at any time up to immediately prior to the close of business on the day prior to the redemption date.
The company said it will pay no dividends on the convertible preferred stock for the period June 30 to, but not including, the redemption date.
As a result of the redemption, up to 7,227,919 shares of common stock will be issued. The company said it currently has approximately 71,719,723 shares of common stock outstanding.

The company is sending a notice of redemption to the registered holders of the convertible preferred stock, including a letter of transmittal to be used in surrendering certificates for redemption. BankBoston Corp is serving as exchange agent.
Kaiser Aluminum produces alumina, primary aluminum and fabricated aluminum products and is a major supplier of alumina and primary aluminum in the domestic and international markets.

MAXXAM Inc directly and indirectly holds approximately 62 percent of Kaiser on a fully diluted basis and will own approximately 63 percent after giving effect to the redemption of the convertible preferred stock.
